name: Hex
description: The keeper. The same sealed suit under a long coat of suit fabric that falls to the shins, worked on the chest with the hive's cells in a lighter thread — the hexagon it used to be. On the back, on a frame, a brood pack: the puckered vent plate that pushes out grubs, with two grubs riding it already, one over the shoulder and one at the hip, that never stop moving, because a grub does not know it is not at home; a feed line runs from the pack up into the helmet, and a tall sensor mast stands off the frame above the shoulder. The arms are the slightest on the roster; Hex does not hit anything itself, it sends things. Two long dead feelers rise from the crown and curve back. Dark violet on the coat's hem and in the visor. Same dead core in the chest. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: a keeper's stance: a slow breath, the mast swaying a degree over the shoulder, the vent on the back puckering open and shut on its own slower beat, and both grubs wriggling where they cling

walk.description: a measured stride under a load and a long coat: the coat swings over the shins, the pack rides the back, the mast rocks, the grubs cling harder
